_comment: Astra Militarum citations (iter-14). Covers the Combined Arms detachment rule (Born Soldiers), the Voice of Command army-wide Order economy, the four wired Officer Orders (Take Aim!, Fix Bayonets!, FRFSRF, Take Cover!), and the six Combined Arms detachment stratagems (Coordinated Action, Reinforcements!, Flexible Command, Fields of Fire, Inspired Command, Stalwart Protector). All entries cite the Wahapedia AM faction page; per-stratagem quoted_text fields are codex-verbatim quotes captured from the Wahapedia detachment block.

simulator.sticky_objective.astra_militar.rule_name: Shock Troops (Cadian Shock Troops datasheet ability)
simulator.sticky_objective.astra_militar.quoted_text: At the end of your Command phase, if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
simulator.sticky_objective.astra_militar.trigger: ADOPTED default-on (wave 255; SWEG_AM_STICKY_CADIAN=0 is the byte-identical kill-switch); at the end of the controlling player's Command phase, the Cadian Shock Troops unit is within range of and controls an objective marker (strictly greater Level of Control than the opponent)
simulator.sticky_objective.astra_militar.effect: Sets the existing sticky_objective profile flag True for astra_militarum_cadian_shock_troops via data/overrides.json, honoured by default (key-scoped guard in code/bsdata/loader.py _apply_override; SWEG_AM_STICKY_CADIAN=0 is the byte-identical kill-switch that leaves sticky_objective=False, identical to the flag being absent). With the gate on, the simulator's _score_objectives sticky mechanic (simulator.py ~1058-1211) records the unit as sticky when it wins the objective, persists ownership across rounds even after the unit leaves, and clears it only when an opposing unit takes strictly-greater Level of Control. Same machinery as Necron Warriors (Their Number Is Legion) and Genestealer Cults Acolyte Hybrids (Cult Ambush). Approximation: the profile flag treats sticky as permanent-while-flagged rather than re-checking the within-range-at-end-of-Command-phase condition each round, matching the existing simulator.sticky_objective approximation.

simulator.am_battleline_special_weapons.rule_name: Cadian Shock Troops / Death Korps of Krieg — special weapon wargear options
simulator.am_battleline_special_weapons.quoted_text: For every 10 models in this unit, up to 2 Cadian Shock Troopers can each have their lasgun replaced with one of the following: 1 flamer; 1 grenade launcher; 1 meltagun; 1 plasma gun. [Plasma gun - supercharge: Range 24", A 1, BS 4+, S 8, AP -3, D 2, [HAZARDOUS], [RAPID FIRE 1]] [Meltagun: Range 12", A 1, BS 4+, S 9, AP -4, D D6, [MELTA 2]]
simulator.am_battleline_special_weapons.trigger: gate SWEG_AM_BATTLELINE_SPECIALS=1 (default OFF); _build_catalog is constructing the Cadian Shock Troops (astra_militarum_cadian_shock_troops) or Death Korps of Krieg (astra_militarum_death_korps_of_krieg) catalog entry. The BSData v10.6.0 mapper collapses both datasheets to a single lasgun-only model type (model_loadouts has one Lasgun + Close combat weapon entry, extra_ranged_profiles empty), dropping the up-to-2-special-weapons-per-10-models options the datasheet grants. Death Korps of Krieg shares the identical wargear option (the same plasma gun / meltagun / flamer / grenade launcher list). Both are confirmed in the local cache data/bsdata/cache/Imperium - Astra Militarum - Library.cat.gz ('...w/ Special Weapon' selectionEntryGroup carrying a max=2 constraint per 10-model squad).
simulator.am_battleline_special_weapons.effect: When SWEG_AM_BATTLELINE_SPECIALS=1, _am_battleline_specials_loadouts REPLACES the unit's lasgun-only model_loadouts with a heterogeneous list scaled per 10 models: 8 lasgun troopers + 1 model armed with a supercharge plasma gun (S8 AP-3 D2 mean 2.0, [RAPID FIRE 1], range 24") + 1 model armed with a meltagun (S9 AP-4 D6 mean 3.5, [MELTA 2], range 12"). The special-weapon model dicts are built by copying the mapper's base lasgun model (inheriting hit_probability 0.5 = Guardsman BS 4+, the Close combat weapon melee, and every other round-trip key) and swapping only the ranged weapon. Army._add_squad_per_model then promotes one plasma-armed and one meltagun-armed model_Unit (via _distribute_squad_slots: the two count-1 special slots + 8 lasgun body slots for a 10-model squad). Modelled per-model (not as whole-unit extra_ranged_profiles) because only 2 of every 10 models carry a special weapon. APPROXIMATION: the plasma supercharge [HAZARDOUS] self-harm is carried in the loadout dict but, per the existing per-model promotion convention (_loadout_entry_to_weapon_fields deliberately does not copy hazardous onto a promoted primary weapon), does not fire when the plasma gun is the model's sole ranged weapon; the flamer / grenade-launcher options are not modelled (plasma + meltagun chosen as the representative 2). Setting SWEG_AM_BATTLELINE_SPECIALS unset or 0 skips the block entirely — byte-identical to the legacy lasgun-only catalogue.

COMBINED_REGIMENT.am_born_soldiers_letha.quoted_text: Each time a model in a **^^Regiment^^** unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible unit (excluding **^^Monsters^^** and **^^Vehicles^^**) that attack has the **[LETHAL HITS]** ability. Each time a model in a **^^Squadron^^** unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible **^^Monster^^** or **^^Vehicle^^** unit, that attack has the **[LETHAL HITS]** ability.
COMBINED_REGIMENT.am_born_soldiers_letha.trigger: any ranged attack made by a friendly AM REGIMENT (vs non-VEHICLE/MONSTER target) OR SQUADRON (vs VEHICLE/MONSTER target)
COMBINED_REGIMENT.am_born_soldiers_letha.effect: the attack gains [LETHAL HITS] (Critical Hits auto-wound). Simulator gate: Unit.attack's `effective_lethal_hits` branch ORs in True when faction is Astra Militarum, mode is ranged, and the REGIMENT-vs-non-V/M or SQUADRON-vs-V/M matrix matches. LEGACY PROXY (default, SWEG_BORN_REGIMENT unset or '0'): AM-DIAG-2 (2026-05-24) narrowed the REGIMENT proxy from INFANTRY to BATTLELINE after the INFANTRY mapping over-granted LETHAL HITS to 40+ non-REGIMENT INFANTRY units (Tempestus Scions / Kasrkin / Aquilons / Ratlings / Ogryns / Bullgryns / Commissars etc.). BATTLELINE catches the three core REGIMENT troops the rule was written for (Cadian Shock Troops, Catachan Jungle Fighters, Death Korps of Krieg); it under-covers non-BATTLELINE REGIMENT units (Kasrkin, Heavy Weapons Squads, Attilan Rough Riders, Field Ordnance Battery, etc.). CORRECTED GATE (SWEG_BORN_REGIMENT='1', wave 247): wave 243 made REGIMENT a first-class tracked keyword from BSData categoryLinks (31 units), enabling the codex-literal 'REGIMENT' keyword check. With the gate enabled, all REGIMENT datasheets — including Kasrkin, Heavy Weapons Squads, Attilan Rough Riders, and other non-BATTLELINE REGIMENT units — correctly receive LETHAL HITS vs non-VEHICLE/MONSTER targets. BSData verbatim wording confirmed from local cache: Imperium - Astra Militarum - Library.cat.gz, rule id b65e-c54b-b8fe-e8e2. SQUADRON leg (name-allowlist, unchanged): attacker name is in _AM_BORN_SOLDIERS_SQUADRON_NAMES vs VEHICLE/MONSTER target.

COMBINED_ARMS.am_born_soldiers_lethal_hi.rule_name: Born Soldiers (Combined Arms Detachment Rule) — alias
COMBINED_ARMS.am_born_soldiers_lethal_hi.quoted_text: Each time a model in a REGIMENT unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES), that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability. Each time a model in a SQUADRON unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
COMBINED_ARMS.am_born_soldiers_lethal_hi.trigger: any ranged attack made by a friendly AM REGIMENT (vs non-VEHICLE/MONSTER target) OR SQUADRON (vs VEHICLE/MONSTER target)
COMBINED_ARMS.am_born_soldiers_lethal_hi.effect: alias of COMBINED_REGIMENT.am_born_soldiers_lethal_hits — both module-level symbols (COMBINED_REGIMENT, COMBINED_ARMS) point to the same Detachment instance after the iter-14 codex-name rename. See the COMBINED_REGIMENT.* entry above for the full effect notes; this duplicate citation exists because the rule auditor scans dir(det_module) and finds both symbol names. NOTE: wave 247 added SWEG_BORN_REGIMENT gate — when set to '1', Born Soldiers checks the codex-literal REGIMENT keyword (wave 243 first-class tracked keyword) instead of the legacy BATTLELINE proxy.

simulator.voice_of_command_orders.rule_name: Voice of Command (Astra Militarum Army Rule)
simulator.voice_of_command_orders.quoted_text: If your Army Faction is ASTRA MILITARUM, OFFICER models with this ability can issue Orders. Each OFFICER's datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue in a battle round and which units are eligible to receive those Orders.
simulator.voice_of_command_orders.trigger: start of each Command phase, on each alive AM OFFICER datasheet (per `code.orders.AM_OFFICER_NAMES` allowlist) within 6" of an eligible REGIMENT or SQUADRON target
simulator.voice_of_command_orders.effect: each Officer issues Orders to its codex-permitted target types within 6", up to the per-Officer count in `code.orders.OFFICER_ORDER_PROFILES`. Each Order applies a single transient buff for the round (Take Aim! / Fix Bayonets! / First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire! / Take Cover!). No Order stacking — a unit holds at most one Order per round. The simulator stores one Unit instance per physical model, so the dispatcher groups model-instances into codex units by squad_id: an Order is applied to every model of the chosen squad and the squad counts as one target for the no-stacking rule (wave 243 correction — previously an Order buffed a single model, diluting its value by squad size). Battle-shocked Officers and Battle-shocked targets are excluded. Wired in `code/orders.py`; called from `Battle._run_round` after the per-round command point drip and stratagem dispatch. Wave 237: per-Officer target-type restriction is now fully enforced — `OFFICER_ORDER_PROFILES` maps every Officer to (max_orders, frozenset of target-type keyword categories) sourced from the BSData Library Astra Militarum cache. The dispatcher filters each Officer's target pool by its own restriction (REGIMENT / SQUADRON / TITANIC keyword). Wave 243: REGIMENT and SQUADRON are now real codex keywords tracked from BSData categoryLinks (mapper `_TRACKED_UNIT_KEYWORDS`), replacing the old BATTLELINE+INFANTRY and BATTLELINE+VEHICLE proxies. This means Kasrkin, Tempestus Scions, Heavy Weapons Squads, all Leman Russ variants, Rogal Dorn tanks, Sentinels, and all SQUADRON vehicles that carry the real BSData keyword are now Order-eligible when targeted by an Officer whose profile includes SQUADRON. The Flexible Command (Combined Arms, 2 command points) stratagem OR-widens the eligible-target set to include SQUADRON units for the round it fires, independently of per-Officer limits. Lord Solar Leontus's Orders profile (BSData cat.gz unit id a9d-55c1-3d24-fa25, Orders profile id 4768-11ce-3c8b-3ce4; cross-checked Wahapedia https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/astra-militarum/Lord-Solar-Leontus) allows REGIMENT, SQUADRON, TITANIC at 3 Orders per round. Issuer gate narrowed (AM-DIAG, 2026-05-24): previously the dispatcher accepted ANY AM CHARACTER as an Order issuer, which mis-treated Commissar / Yarrick / Graves / Ministorum Priest / Tech-Priest Enginseer / Primaris Psyker / Nork Deddog / Ogryn Bodyguard / Sly Marbo / Straken / Harker / Gaunt's Ghosts / Hell's Last / Rein and Raus / Quartermaster / Death Rider Commissar as Officers. The new gate (`AM_OFFICER_NAMES`) is the Wahapedia OFFICER-keyword allowlist, populated by reading each AM CHARACTER datasheet's keyword line

Order.Take Aim!.quoted_text: Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
Order.Take Aim!.trigger: Order issued by an AM OFFICER during the Command phase to an eligible REGIMENT or SQUADRON target within 6"
Order.Take Aim!.effect: sets `Unit.transient_plus_one_to_hit_shooting` on the target for the round (Unit.attack reads the flag and applies +1 to the ranged Hit roll). CLEAN MAPPING — codex 'improve ballistic skill by 1' is arithmetically identical to '+1 to hit roll' at every ballistic-skill bracket. The AI picks this Order when the target has no other Order yet and has lower ranged DPA than the FRFSRF threshold (fallback)

Order.Fix Bayonets!.quoted_text: Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
Order.Fix Bayonets!.trigger: Order issued by an AM OFFICER during the Command phase to an eligible REGIMENT or SQUADRON target within 6"
Order.Fix Bayonets!.effect: (APPROXIMATION) routes the offensive payoff through `Unit.transient_plus_one_to_wound_melee` on the target for the round — codex effect is 'improve weapon skill by 1' (a melee hit-roll buff) but SwegHammer's existing transient layer has no per-unit +1-to-hit-melee flag, so we proxy through +1 to wound to capture the offensive payoff via a single existing transient. Same direction (more landed melee damage), comparable magnitude on a 4+ wound roll. The AI picks Fix Bayonets! when the target has meaningful melee DPA AND low ranged DPA (Ogryns / Bullgryns canonical) — Lasgun-block Cadians take FRFSRF instead

Order.First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fir.rule_name: First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire! (Astra Militarum Order)
Order.First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fir.quoted_text: Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
Order.First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fir.trigger: Order issued by an AM OFFICER during the Command phase to an eligible REGIMENT or SQUADRON target within 6"
Order.First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fir.effect: FAITHFUL MAPPING (wave 236 NE-2): sets `Unit.transient_frfsrf_active` on the target for the round. The codex text has no range condition; Unit.compute_expected_kills reads the flag and adds +1 to n_attacks for every weapon profile with rapid_fire > 0, unconditionally at all ranges (the existing half-range Rapid Fire bonus at line ~2010 is separate and unchanged). Cross-checked: Wahapedia AM faction page + BSData Library cat.gz both carry the verbatim text above. The AI picks FRFSRF as the canonical Lasgun-block Order — any unit with real ranged DPA (>= 0.5) that carries at least one Rapid Fire weapon qualifies (Rapid Fire gate added in wave 243: the rule text buffs Rapid Fire weapons exclusively, so issuing this Order to a no-Rapid-Fire unit such as a Leman Russ does nothing — the picker gives those Take Aim! instead).

Order.Take Cover!.quoted_text: Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model's Save to better than 3+).
Order.Take Cover!.trigger: Order issued by an AM OFFICER during the Command phase to an eligible REGIMENT or SQUADRON target within 6"
Order.Take Cover!.effect: sets `Unit.transient_plus_one_save` on the target for the round (Unit.attack reads the flag when computing save_after_ap and lowers the save target by 1, capped at 2+ via the existing transient_plus_one_save plumbing). APPROXIMATION: the codex caps at 3+, SwegHammer's flag caps at 2+ — the wider cap rarely binds for AM REGIMENT units (saves are 5+/4+ across Cadians/Krieg/Catachan/Kasrkin/Scions). The AI picks Take Cover! when the target has lost more than 20% of starting HP (defensive priority)

Order.Duty and Honour!.quoted_text: Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.
Order.Duty and Honour!.trigger: Order issued by an AM OFFICER during the Command phase to an eligible REGIMENT or SQUADRON target within 6" that is sitting on / contesting an objective marker
Order.Duty and Honour!.effect: sets `Unit.transient_plus_one_oc` on the target for the round; `Battle._effective_oc` reads the flag (behind SWEG_AM_DUTY_AND_HONOUR) and adds 1 to each model's Objective Control before the damaged-bracket reduction. APPROXIMATION: the codex Order also improves Leadership by 1, but Leadership is not read by any scoring path in the simulator, so only the Objective Control half is modelled. The AI dispatcher picks this Order ahead of the offensive Orders when the target squad has at least one alive member within an objective's control_radius

Stratagem.Coordinated Action.quoted_text: WHEN: Start of any phase. TARGET: One REGIMENT unit from your army and one SQUADRON unit from your army within 6" of and visible to that REGIMENT unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, Orders affecting one of your units affect the other, and vice versa.
Stratagem.Coordinated Action.trigger: start of any phase, on a REGIMENT + SQUADRON pair within 6" of and visible to each other
Stratagem.Coordinated Action.effect: (APPROXIMATION) the simulator routes the offensive payoff through `transient_plus_one_to_hit_shooting` on the highest-DPA AM SQUADRON (VEHICLE) for the round — the canonical use case is extending Take Aim! from an Infantry Squad to a Leman Russ pair, which the +1-to-hit-shooting proxy captures exactly. The two-unit-pair gate is collapsed to 'apply the buff directly to the SQUADRON' since the simulator's Order economy doesn't expose a 'mirror Order to another unit' hook. Direction-correct; same lossy pattern as Mont'ka Focused Fire. 1 CP per Combined Arms. AM-DIAG-4 (2026-05-24): added anti-stack guard — dispatcher now skips fire if the chosen SQUADRON already holds any transient Order buff for the round (matches the codex no-op behaviour when mirroring an Order onto a unit that already holds it).

Stratagem.Reinforcements!.quoted_text: WHEN: Any phase. TARGET: One INFANTRY REGIMENT unit from your army that was just destroyed. EFFECT: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with all of its wounds remaining.
Stratagem.Reinforcements!.trigger: any phase, when an INFANTRY REGIMENT unit from an Astra Militarum Combined Arms army is just destroyed (once per battle, 2 CP)
Stratagem.Reinforcements!.effect: (APPROXIMATION — gated SWEG_REINFORCEMENTS, default-off) wave 248 built the dispatcher: `_try_reinforcements` fires at round end (next to _apply_cult_ambush_resurgence in `_run_round_end`), scans `army.units` for dead INFANTRY REGIMENT non-CHARACTER units, picks the highest-points candidate, checks the AI gate (unit cost >= 60 pts) and the once-per-battle gate, spends 2 CP via `_fire_stratagem`, restores current_health to starting health, and injects the unit into `self._reserves[army.name]` so it arrives via the existing reserves-arrival pass (>9" placement) on the next round. TIMING APPROXIMATION: codex trigger is reactive ("any phase, just after" destruction); SwegHammer fires at round end — the respawned unit arrives one round later than the codex allows. The once-per-battle constraint is enforced by `_fire_stratagem` (REINFORCEMENTS.once_per_battle=True).

simulator.reinforcements_stratagem.quoted_text: WHEN: Any phase. TARGET: One INFANTRY REGIMENT unit from your army that was just destroyed. EFFECT: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with all of its wounds remaining.
simulator.reinforcements_stratagem.trigger: gate SWEG_REINFORCEMENTS=1; at round end, when an Astra Militarum Combined Arms army has at least one dead INFANTRY REGIMENT non-CHARACTER unit and >= 2 command points and has not yet fired Reinforcements! this battle
simulator.reinforcements_stratagem.effect: Picks the highest-points dead INFANTRY REGIMENT unit (cost >= 60 pts AI gate), restores it to full health, and injects it into `_reserves[army.name]` for arrival next round via the existing Deep Strike arrival pass (>9" from all enemies). The injection does NOT immediately call `_add_live_unit` — the unit re-enters via the standard `_process_reserves` loop the following round, so it cannot act this round. TIMING APPROXIMATION: codex fires reactively mid-phase; simulator fires at round end after all combat. Once-per-battle enforced by `_fire_stratagem` (REINFORCEMENTS.once_per_battle=True). Default-off (SWEG_REINFORCEMENTS unset or '0' = zero extra RNG draws, zero CP spend, zero behaviour change).

Stratagem.Flexible Command.quoted_text: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: Any number of ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER units from your army. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your Officers can issue Orders to REGIMENT units and SQUADRON units.
Stratagem.Flexible Command.trigger: your Command phase, on any number of AM OFFICER units
Stratagem.Flexible Command.effect: CLEAN MAPPING: sets `Army.orders_eligible_squadron_this_round = True` for the round, which `code.orders._is_order_target_eligible` reads when filtering the target pool for Order issuance. Stratagem dispatch runs BEFORE Order dispatch in `Battle._run_round`, so the flag is honoured by the same-round Order issuance — AM SQUADRON (BATTLELINE VEHICLE) units like Leman Russ Battle Tank become eligible to receive Orders (typically Take Aim! / FRFSRF). 2 CP per Combined Arms

Stratagem.Fields of Fire.quoted_text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One REGIMENT unit and one SQUADRON unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot. EFFECT: Each time your selected units make an attack targeting that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.
Stratagem.Fields of Fire.trigger: your Shooting phase, on a REGIMENT + SQUADRON pair vs a chosen enemy unit
Stratagem.Fields of Fire.effect: (APPROXIMATION) routes the offensive payoff through `transient_plus_one_to_hit_shooting` on the highest-ranged-DPA AM unit (any keyword) for the round — the AP+1 codex effect translates as 'more landed wounds get through saves'; +1 to hit is the closest single-flag proxy that produces the same direction of damage swing. The two-unit-pair gate is collapsed to 'apply the buff to the highest-DPA AM unit'. Same lossy pattern as Mont'ka Focused Fire / Custodes Archaeotech Munitions. 1 CP per Combined Arms. AM-DIAG-4 (2026-05-24): the highest-DPA picker now filters out units that already hold `transient_plus_one_to_hit_shooting` from a prior Order / Coordinated Action this round. This prevents the dispatcher from spending CP to re-set an idempotent boolean (no-op) and narrows the per-round magnitude to a single extra shooter.

simulator.officer_follow_piloting.rule_name: Voice of Command (Astra Militarum Army Rule) — piloting heuristic
simulator.officer_follow_piloting.quoted_text: If your Army Faction is ASTRA MILITARUM, OFFICER models with this ability can issue Orders. Each OFFICER's datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue in a battle round and which units are eligible to receive those Orders.
simulator.officer_follow_piloting.trigger: SWEG_OFFICER_FOLLOW=1; moving unit is an AM OFFICER (name in AM_OFFICER_NAMES); nearest host-key squad is more than OFFICER_AURA_RANGE (6.0") away
simulator.officer_follow_piloting.effect: ARTIFICIAL-INTELLIGENCE PILOTING HEURISTIC — not a 10e rules claim. Inserts a move-intent override in pick_move_intent (code/strategy.py) that directs drifted officers toward their nearest eligible host squad before any other intent fires. This preserves the 6" Order-issuance range required by Voice of Command so Orders do not silently drop to zero after round 2 (the drift diagnostic measured 8.5-14.2" separation by round 3 → zero Orders). The heuristic does not override the hold-objective intent (that fires earlier in pick_move_intent) and does not fire when the officer is already within 6" of its host. Multi-model squads (Cadian Command Squad, 5 models) use the squad centroid rather than a single model position. Wave-245 extension (SWEG_SOLAR_SQUADRON=1): Lord Solar Leontus's host coverage expands to also include five SQUADRON vehicle catalog keys (Leman Russ Battle Tank, Leman Russ Demolisher, Rogal Dorn Battle Tank, Basilisk, Manticore) so the hook can pull him toward unordered SQUADRON vehicles when no infantry host pull applies — preventing his three SQUADRON Orders per round from wasting because he is held mid-table by the infantry pull.

SWEG_FIXBAYONETS.fix_bayonets_engagement.rule_name: Fix Bayonets! (Astra Militarum Order) — engagement-range routing guard
SWEG_FIXBAYONETS.fix_bayonets_engagement.quoted_text: Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
SWEG_FIXBAYONETS.fix_bayonets_engagement.trigger: SWEG_FIXBAYONETS=1; AM OFFICER issues an Order to a melee-statted squad (melee damage-per-activation > 0.5, ranged damage-per-activation < 0.3) during the Command phase
SWEG_FIXBAYONETS.fix_bayonets_engagement.effect: ARTIFICIAL-INTELLIGENCE PILOTING HEURISTIC — not a 10e rules claim. The Fix Bayonets! Order's weapon-skill buff (codex text above; BSData: Imperium - Astra Militarum - Library.cat.gz, verbatim from the Voice of Command Orders table) only delivers value when the recipient squad is actively fighting in melee. Issuing the Order to an unengaged squad wastes the slot because the weapon-skill improvement cannot fire until the squad enters Engagement Range. When SWEG_FIXBAYONETS=1, the Order scorer in _pick_order_for_target skips ORDER_FIX_BAYONETS for squads that have no member within 1.0" base-edge Engagement Range of any live enemy (computed via code.sim.geometry._er_gap, the same function used for all Engagement Range checks in the simulator); those squads fall through to the next-best Order (Take Aim! or First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire! if they have ranged weapons, else Take Aim!). Engaged squads and the gate-off path are byte-identical to pre-248. Gate default-off (SWEG_FIXBAYONETS=0).
